entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I just received official confirmat..."
entries.dialogueText: "I just received official confirmation that our neighbor has been accepted into the Arcasian Treaty Organization."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Wehlen?""
entries.dialogueText: "Wehlen?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Morella?""
entries.dialogueText: "Morella?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Lespia?""
entries.dialogueText: "Lespia?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Derdia?""
entries.dialogueText: "Derdia?"

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Precisely. Prime Minister Alvarez..."
entries.dialogueText: "Precisely. Prime Minister Alvarez will make the official announcement tomorrow."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Didn't we all see this coming? It..."
entries.dialogueText: "Didn't we all see this coming? It should hardly be a surprise."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Are you trying to be humorous, You..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you trying to be humorous, Your Majesty?"

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I'm sure that was a joke. He knows..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sure that was a joke. He knows it could only have been Lespia."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Thank you for updating us, Mr. Esq..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for updating us, Mr. Esquibel. I suggest we set a date for a meeting to discuss Lespia's ATO membership as well as our general foreign policy strategy."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I had barely even started my reign,..."
entries.dialogueText: I had barely even started my reign, and it already felt like the ground was shifting beneath my feet.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "What other challenges lay in store?"
entries.dialogueText: What other challenges lay in store?

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Indeed, this development has been..."
entries.dialogueText: "Indeed, this development has been on the horizon for some time. But our relations with our neighbors are sure to change because of it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "On the way back from the Plavo Arch..."
entries.dialogueText: On the way back from the Plavo Archsanctuary, I met my council in the city of Folce Dator for a briefing on our security and military situation.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The so-called "Forge of Rizia" was..."
entries.dialogueText: The so-called "Forge of Rizia" was famous for its numerous foundries and factories, in which iron from the nearby hills was transformed into rifles and handguns.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Largest of them all was the Royal F..."
entries.dialogueText: Largest of them all was the Royal Folce Foundry, responsible for supplying the Rizian police and military. The red brick complex towered at the end of the King's Avenue, Folce Dator's main road.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My council and I were given a tour..."
entries.dialogueText: My council and I were given a tour of the facilities before settling around the table in the foundry's Great Hall. Murals on the walls around us depicted the city's history as an industrial center.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As duchess of the province and my w..."
entries.dialogueText: As duchess of the province and my war and security councilor, Lucita sat at the head of the table. She nodded at the rest of us.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Your Majesty, Your Highness, my es..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty, Your Highness, my esteemed fellow councilors."

entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Your Majesty, my esteemed fellow c..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty, my esteemed fellow councilors."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I planned this meeting here so tha..."
entries.dialogueText: "I planned this meeting here so that the King would have a shorter journey after his consecration ceremony."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A corner of her mouth twisted upwar..."
entries.dialogueText: A corner of her mouth twisted upwards.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Serendipitously, His Majesty's wis..."
entries.dialogueText: "Serendipitously, His Majesty's wise rejection of the ceremony has left us with more time to spend in this fine city."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I'm sure the proceedings were very..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sure the proceedings were very taxing, Your Majesty. Whatever they were."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What happened in Plavo is between..."
entries.dialogueText: "What happened in Plavo is between me and God."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're wrong, Duchess Azaro. I hav..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're wrong, Duchess Azaro. I have never felt so invigorated."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It was taxing, for sure. But it wa..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was taxing, for sure. But it was my duty as King to bear that burden."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Let's hope that something useful c..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let's hope that something useful came out of all that."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I'm glad to hear it. Religion has..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm glad to hear it. Religion has that effect on some people, I'm told."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""And the Grand Wiseman, of course.""
entries.dialogueText: "And the Grand Wiseman, of course."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Sal was sitting across from me, sti..."
entries.dialogueText: Sal was sitting across from me, still wearing his robes. He smiled enigmatically.

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""I am but a lowly conduit between H..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am but a lowly conduit between His Majesty and the powers above, Ms. Azaro."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Even if you are not a believer, Ms..."
entries.dialogueText: "Even if you are not a believer, Ms. Azaro, I assure you the six stars of St. Wruhec shine upon your house and our troops."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Sal was sitting across from me, sti..."
entries.dialogueText: Sal was sitting across from me, still wearing his robes. He smiled enigmatically.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Sal was sitting across from me, sti..."
entries.dialogueText: Sal was sitting across from me, still wearing his robes. He smiled enigmatically.

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Religion is not a tool to be used,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Religion is not a tool to be used, Ms. Azaro. It is a guiding light that shines even on those who do not believe in it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo nodded approvingly."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo nodded approvingly.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I know better than to pry into the..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know better than to pry into the contents of the ceremony, Your Majesty. But I will say I hope it was an enlightening experience."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""You may proceed with your briefing..."
entries.dialogueText: "You may proceed with your briefing, Duchess Azaro."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""With great pleasure, Your Grace.""
entries.dialogueText: "With great pleasure, Your Grace."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She gestured at one of the murals o..."
entries.dialogueText: She gestured at one of the murals on the wall. It depicted a beautiful but severe-looking woman riding a horse down the King's Avenue, her rifle at the ready.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""My ancestress Ana Azaro ordered th..."
entries.dialogueText: "My ancestress Ana Azaro ordered the construction of this foundry in 1812, immediately after the end of the War of Rizian Succession."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""House Azaro knows that 'peacetime'..."
entries.dialogueText: "House Azaro knows that 'peacetime' is not a period of rest. It is a time to gather our strength and hone our weapons for when they are next needed."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Because they most certainly *will*..."
entries.dialogueText: "Because they most certainly *will* be needed."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's a rather pessimistic view,..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's a rather pessimistic view, Duchess Azaro. Isn't peace the final state that all nations strive towards?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I agree with you completely, Duche..."
entries.dialogueText: "I agree with you completely, Duchess. Rizia has become soft and complacent during these conflict-free years."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We can also use peacetime to form..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can also use peacetime to form new alliances and improve international relations. Strength is about more than just weaponry."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes, we should remain vigilant and..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, we should remain vigilant and prepared. But not to the point where our military focus detracts from the needs of the Rizian people."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Well said, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Well said, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Alliances can shift. Treaties can..."
entries.dialogueText: "Alliances can shift. Treaties can be broken. We should not be so naive as to assume every nation will respect diplomatic boundaries."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Safety is at the top of the hierar..."
entries.dialogueText: "Safety is at the top of the hierarchy of our people's needs, is it not? Everything else is optional."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Ideally, maybe. But reality has ta..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ideally, maybe. But reality has taught us that peace is fragile. We can only preserve it with hard work and a firm hand."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Not without reason, of course.""
entries.dialogueText: "Not without reason, of course."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Our failure to win the Reclamation..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our failure to win the Reclamation War and the rebellion of 1926 served as a double blow to the Rizian armed forces."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I could hear the passion rising in..."
entries.dialogueText: I could hear the passion rising in her voice.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Even after my father purged the tr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Even after my father purged the troops and general staff of all suspected traitors to the throne, His Majesty King Valero was reluctant to restore our military to its former strength."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""As a result, Your Majesty, we are..."
entries.dialogueText: "As a result, Your Majesty, we are ludicrously underprepared for a country of our size."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "With lightning speed, she reached u..."
entries.dialogueText: With lightning speed, she reached under the table, pulled out a knife and hurled it in the direction of the doorway. Titus languidly snatched it out of the air.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have a few more questions regard..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have a few more questions regarding the military."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I'm here to answer them, Your Maje..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm here to answer them, Your Majesty. Where should I start?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What's the state of our military p..."
entries.dialogueText: "What's the state of our military production industry?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Tell me more about our naval and a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Tell me more about our naval and air capabilities."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let's talk about army conscription..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let's talk about army conscription. How do we bolster our ranks?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Does our internal security need im..."
entries.dialogueText: "Does our internal security need improvement as well?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita sighed."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita sighed.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Despite our very grand surrounding..."
entries.dialogueText: "Despite our very grand surroundings, we have long neglected the potential of Folce Dator."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Rumburg currently supplies us with..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rumburg currently supplies us with the bulk of our weaponry, including their KA-74 rifles."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""But if we invested more into resea..."
entries.dialogueText: "But if we invested more into research, development and production in this city, our small arms industry could become a real force to be reckoned with."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Our navy has actually made signifi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our navy has actually made significant strides in the past 30 years."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""We are a coastal nation, after all..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are a coastal nation, after all, and our fleet is both well-trained and up to date."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Our submarines could use improveme..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our submarines could use improvement, though. Compared to those currently coming out of Rumburg and Valgsland, they're practically ancient."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Our ranks are looking healthy alre..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our ranks are looking healthy already, Your Majesty. But since you asked..."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""As you know, our central royal arm..."
entries.dialogueText: "As you know, our central royal army is fed both by general conscription and levies from the individual provinces."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""If you ask me, the provincial armi..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you ask me, the provincial armies should be pulling more weight. Though I do understand that those of Brenas and Valenqiris are not nearly as well trained as Cardesse-Montaklar's."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't see the need for that. It..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't see the need for that. It seems easier and cheaper to continue importing from Rumburg."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Do we have the capability to build..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do we have the capability to build larger weapons too?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I imagine that would give a boost..."
entries.dialogueText: "I imagine that would give a boost to the local economy as well."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We've got to take our diplomatic s..."
entries.dialogueText: "We've got to take our diplomatic stance into account. Wouldn't a sudden increase in arms production be seen as provocation by our neighbors?"

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""It would, Your Majesty. As long as..."
entries.dialogueText: "It would, Your Majesty. As long as there were enough people available to fill the new positions that would be created."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Not currently, Your Majesty. Even..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not currently, Your Majesty. Even if we were able to begin production in that sector immediately, it would take years before our missile technology caught up to, say, Derdia's."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Producing our own weapons would sa..."
entries.dialogueText: "Producing our own weapons would save us untold amounts in the long run. We could even ask Rumburg for a license to make our own KA-74s."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""On the other hand, larger arms suc..."
entries.dialogueText: "On the other hand, larger arms such as missiles are best purchased from Rumburg. Or barring that, Derdia."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""We would unfortunately still have..."
entries.dialogueText: "We would unfortunately still have to rely on Rumburg for weaponry such as missiles. Although I've also seen promising developments in Derdia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Hmm. A weapons deal with Derdia co..."
entries.dialogueText: "Hmm. A weapons deal with Derdia could help improve relations between our countries."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We shouldn't bother with Derdia. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "We shouldn't bother with Derdia. I'm counting on a stable trade relationship with Rumburg."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I doubt Derdia will sell us weapon..."
entries.dialogueText: "I doubt Derdia will sell us weapons considering our religious differences."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""It would depend on what they'd dem..."
entries.dialogueText: "It would depend on what they'd demand in return, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Yes, I'm afraid any negotiation wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, I'm afraid any negotiation with Derdia would be more trouble than it's worth."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This is ridiculous. What would we..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is ridiculous. What would we need missiles for?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""The wars to come will not be fough..."
entries.dialogueText: "The wars to come will not be fought with guns alone, Your Majesty. We all know that."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Everyone has a price, Your Majesty..."
entries.dialogueText: "Everyone has a price, Your Majesty. It would depend on what Rizia is willing to pay."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""But I've set aside time to discuss..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I've set aside time to discuss Derdia during our upcoming foreign policy meeting."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I personally believe attempting to..."
entries.dialogueText: "I personally believe attempting to sign an arms deal with Derdia would be more trouble than it's worth."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""On the contrary, Your Majesty, it..."
entries.dialogueText: "On the contrary, Your Majesty, it might serve as a deterrent. A nation that invests in producing high-quality weaponry is not one that you want to provoke."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Actually, were our foundries in Fo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Actually, were our foundries in Folce Dator to become productive enough, we could use rifles as yet another trade resource."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I suggest we think about procuring..."
entries.dialogueText: "I suggest we think about procuring larger weapons as well. Derdian missiles, for example."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I look forward to that conversatio..."
entries.dialogueText: "I look forward to that conversation, Mr. Esquibel. Where were we, Your Majesty?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Our air force, meanwhile, is still..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our air force, meanwhile, is still suffering the consequences of the Pales campaign."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo wore a disproving look on his..."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo wore a disproving look on his face. Across from me, Sal was smiling beatifically.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't need a ceremony to validat..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't need a ceremony to validate my God-given right to rule."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My apologies once again, Grand Wis..."
entries.dialogueText: "My apologies once again, Grand Wiseman Ignacius. I did not mean to disrespect the Wruhecist faith."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I made the right decision. Arcane..."
entries.dialogueText: "I made the right decision. Arcane religious rituals have no place in modern politics."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I had my reasons for not participa..."
entries.dialogueText: "I had my reasons for not participating in the ceremony. I don't want any of you questioning them."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Whatever your personal feelings ab..."
entries.dialogueText: "Whatever your personal feelings about the ceremony, Your Majesty, Rizia is a Wruhecist country. Breaking such a centuries-old tradition will have repercussions."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""These rituals connect us to our pa..."
entries.dialogueText: "These rituals connect us to our past. A good leader draws not only on God for guidance, but on those who came before him."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Do not chastise your nephew too ha..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do not chastise your nephew too harshly, Your Grace. King Romus must find the divine path on his own."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Do not fear, Your Majesty. The div..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do not fear, Your Majesty. The divine path is yours to find on your own. Nobody can force you onto it."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Still, Rizia is a Wruhecist countr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Still, Rizia is a Wruhecist country. It might have been wise to participate if only for the public's approval."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""The public will not approve of you..."
entries.dialogueText: "The public will not approve of your decision, Your Majesty. But perhaps it will command respect among certain international factions."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Quite right. A man's faith is a pe..."
entries.dialogueText: "Quite right. A man's faith is a personal matter. The King must be allowed to find his path on his own."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Halaita, Grand Wiseman.""
entries.dialogueText: "Halaita, Grand Wiseman."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""But what's been done is done.""
entries.dialogueText: "But what's been done is done."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""At any rate... what's been done is..."
entries.dialogueText: "At any rate... what's been done is done."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Thank you for your reminder, Grand..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for your reminder, Grand Wiseman. I am sure he will."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Less so, Your Majesty. Our police..."
entries.dialogueText: "Less so, Your Majesty. Our police forces have kept a firm handle on our populace since the uprising."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Civil disobedience in Valenqiris,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Civil disobedience in Valenqiris, for example, is at a historic low thanks to your zero-tolerance policies as Duke. Not that it's ever been high in the era of House Toras."

entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Valenqiris, too, is unlikely to po..."
entries.dialogueText: "Valenqiris, too, is unlikely to pose major difficulties as long as House Toras is on the throne."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""The members of House Sazon who rul..."
entries.dialogueText: "The members of House Sazon who rule Brenas have mostly fallen in line following the uprising. They're content to use the House of Delegates as a forum for their grievances."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's no surprise that giving part..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's no surprise that giving part of Brenas to House Toras would divide the region."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let me guess. The Wehzek and Derdi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let me guess. The Wehzek and Derdian newcomers have been causing problems."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I knew it. The city was always a s..."
entries.dialogueText: "I knew it. The city was always a stronghold for anti-monarchists."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Well... ruling the Brenas capital..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well... ruling the Brenas capital after its transfer to House Toras would not be an easy task for anyone."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What? Is my cousin failing in his..."
entries.dialogueText: "What? Is my cousin failing in his duties as Duke?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""And the Central Police, headquarte..."
entries.dialogueText: "And the Central Police, headquartered in Rizia Imperii, have been keeping the capital secure."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""We are not seeing anti-monarchist..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are not seeing anti-monarchist activity in Iza, Your Majesty. At least on the surface."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""It's complicated, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "It's complicated, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Complicating matters are the large..."
entries.dialogueText: "Complicating matters are the large numbers of Wehzek migrants who settled in the city following the Civil War."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She took a deep breath."
entries.dialogueText: She took a deep breath.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""If there's a problem area, it's Iz..."
entries.dialogueText: "If there's a problem area, it's Iza."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""But we are seeing complications ha..."
entries.dialogueText: "But we are seeing complications having to do with the Wehzek migrants who settled in the city after the Civil War."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Large numbers of migrants, particu..."
entries.dialogueText: "Large numbers of migrants, particularly Wehzeks fleeing the civil war, settled in the city in the '30s."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""As I mentioned in our earlier meet..."
entries.dialogueText: "As I mentioned in our earlier meeting, some turned to the black market to supplement their meager 'guest worker' income, giving rise to organized crime."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What kind of black-market activiti..."
entries.dialogueText: "What kind of black-market activities?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We can't blame them. They had no o..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can't blame them. They had no other choice."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Hugo, you were in Iza during the '..."
entries.dialogueText: "Hugo, you were in Iza during the '30s. Didn't you try and stop this?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""The drug trade, mostly. There are..."
entries.dialogueText: "The drug trade, mostly. There are cartels connected to families in Wehlen, who in turn answer to powerful distributors in Agard."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""We gave them a home and employment..."
entries.dialogueText: "We gave them a home and employment, Your Majesty. They chose to abuse our hospitality."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I implemented a community policing..."
entries.dialogueText: "I implemented a community policing program. But the criminal networks were too strong."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita sniffed."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita sniffed.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""In my opinion, the growing influen..."
entries.dialogueText: "In my opinion, the growing influence of the nationalist group Su Omina has only inflamed tensions in the area."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I attempted to tackle this myself..."
entries.dialogueText: "I attempted to tackle this myself with a community policing program. But the networks were too strong."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""The King, of course, might disagre..."
entries.dialogueText: "The King, of course, might disagree."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""The good Rizians of Iza are doing..."
entries.dialogueText: "The good Rizians of Iza are doing their best with the resources they've been given, Duchess. My son included."

entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""The problem as I see it lies in th..."
entries.dialogueText: "The problem as I see it lies in the lack of cooperation between the city's police force and those of the surrounding region."

entries.dialogueText: "Yes, I've received Duke Rico's complaints that the Brenas forces have not been providing him with as much aid as he wishes."

entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""As well as his requests that extra..."
entries.dialogueText: "As well as his requests that extra police from our central forces be transferred to Iza and placed under his command. But I don't think that would solve anything."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And why not, Duchess Azaro? I thou..."
entries.dialogueText: "And why not, Duchess Azaro? I thought you were tough on crime yourself."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I believe in the power of a firm h..."
entries.dialogueText: "I believe in the power of a firm hand, Your Majesty. But only when it's exercised with responsibility."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It would set a dangerous precedent..."
entries.dialogueText: "It would set a dangerous precedent. We can't have the other provinces demanding the same."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Exactly.""
entries.dialogueText: "Exactly."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Why aren't the Brenas police coope..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why aren't the Brenas police cooperating?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""They are providing some assistance..."
entries.dialogueText: "They are providing some assistance. But my instinct is that they, like most of House Sazon, disagree with Duke Rico's policies and his associations with Su Omina."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Their political views should not m..."
entries.dialogueText: "Their political views should not matter. Their job is to protect and serve."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Are you calling my son irresponsib..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you calling my son irresponsible, Duchess?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Iza is a special case. I'm sure ev..."
entries.dialogueText: "Iza is a special case. I'm sure everyone is aware of that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're right. Extra force won't so..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're right. Extra force won't solve anything. We need to get to the root of the matter."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Force is absolutely necessary in s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Force is absolutely necessary in some circumstances. But it must be wielded with responsibility."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I am saying that in the wrong hand..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am saying that in the wrong hands, the Central Police could legitimize Su Omina's campaign of oppression, rather than neutralize it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo opened his mouth to respond. L..."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo opened his mouth to respond. Lucita pretended not to notice.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Well, Your Majesty? Shall we conti..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, Your Majesty? Shall we continue with the briefing?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I have the situation under control..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have the situation under control, Your Grace. You don't need to involve yourself with such a minor issue."

entries.dialogueText: "Rest assured that House Toras will not turn on itself. And it will most certainly not countenance being surveilled."
